name: snapprints
description: SnapPrints — backend, customer print page, admin/vendor/officer dashboard, shop print agent and Raspberry Pi kiosk in one project

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix print-app install && npm --prefix dashboard install && npm --prefix shop-agent install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix backend run migrate && npm --prefix backend run seed:dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,print,dash -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix print-app start" "npm --prefix dashboard run dev"
